SELECT * FROM ( SELECT ROWNUM AS RNUM, A.* FROM ( SELECT M.MBR_ID, M.MBR_NM, SUBSTR(M.HP_NO, 1, 3) || '-' || SUBSTR(M.HP_NO, 4, LENGTH(M.HP_NO) - 7) || '-' || SUBSTR(M.HP_NO, -4) AS HP_NO, M.EMAIL, M.BIRTH_YMD, M.GRADE_CD, M.MBR_STAT, M.SMS_RCV_YN, M.EMAIL_RCV_YN, TO_CHAR(M.JOIN_DT, 'YYYYMMDD') AS JOIN_DT, TO_CHAR(M.LAST_LOGIN_DT, 'YYYYMMDD') AS LAST_LOGIN_DT, TO_CHAR(M.GRADE_CHG_DT, 'YYYYMMDD') AS GRADE_CHG_DT, M.RMK FROM TB_MBR M
ORDER BY M.JOIN_DT DESC, M.MBR_ID ) A WHERE ROWNUM <= #{PAGE_NO} * #{PAGE_SIZE} ) WHERE RNUM > (#{PAGE_NO} - 1) * #{PAGE_SIZE}

SELECT MBR_ID, MBR_NM, HP_NO, EMAIL, NVL(GRADE_CD, 'GEN') AS GRADE_CD, MBR_STAT, TO_CHAR(JOIN_DT, 'YYYYMMDD') AS JOIN_DT, TO_CHAR(LAST_LOGIN_DT, 'YYYYMMDD') AS LAST_LOGIN_DT FROM TB_MBR WHERE MBR_ID = #{mbrId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_MBR (MBR_ID, MBR_NM, HP_NO, EMAIL, BIRTH_YMD, GRADE_CD, MBR_STAT, SMS_RCV_YN, EMAIL_RCV_YN, JOIN_DT, RMK, REG_ID) VALUES (#{MBR_ID}, #{MBR_NM}, #{HP_NO}, #{EMAIL}, #{BIRTH_YMD}, #{GRADE_CD}, #{MBR_STAT}, NVL(#{SMS_RCV_YN}, 'N'), NVL(#{EMAIL_RCV_YN}, 'N'), SYSDATE, #{RMK}, #{USER_ID})
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_MBR SET MBR_NM = #{MBR_NM}, HP_NO = #{HP_NO}, EMAIL = #{EMAIL}, BIRTH_YMD = #{BIRTH_YMD}, MBR_STAT = NVL(#{MBR_STAT}, MBR_STAT), SMS_RCV_YN = NVL(#{SMS_RCV_YN}, SMS_RCV_YN), EMAIL_RCV_YN = NVL(#{EMAIL_RCV_YN}, EMAIL_RCV_YN), WTHDR_DT = DECODE(#{MBR_STAT}, 'W', SYSDATE, WTHDR_DT), DRMNT_DT = DECODE(#{MBR_STAT}, 'A', NULL, DRMNT_DT), RMK = #{RMK}, UPD_ID = #{USER_ID}, UPD_DT = SYSDATE WHERE MBR_ID = #{MBR_ID}
UPDATE TB_MBR SET GRADE_CD = #{GRADE_CD}, GRADE_CHG_DT = SYSDATE, UPD_ID = #{USER_ID}, UPD_DT = SYSDATE WHERE MBR_ID = #{MBR_ID}
mapper.select:
SELECT H.MBR_ID, M.MBR_NM, H.HIST_SEQ, H.BF_GRADE_CD, H.AF_GRADE_CD, DECODE(H.CHG_TYPE, 'B', '배치', 'M', '수동', H.CHG_TYPE) AS CHG_TYPE_NM, H.CNFM_AMT_6M, H.CHG_RSN, TO_CHAR(H.CHG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS CHG_DT, H.CHG_ID FROM TB_MBR_GRADE_HIST H JOIN TB_MBR M ON M.MBR_ID = H.MBR_ID
AND H.MBR_ID = #{MBR_ID} AND H.CHG_TYPE = #{CHG_TYPE} AND H.CHG_DT >= TO_DATE(#{FROM_DT}, 'YYYYMMDD') AND H.CHG_DT < TO_DATE(#{TO_DT}, 'YYYYMMDD') + 1
ORDER BY H.CHG_DT DESC, H.HIST_SEQ DESC
SELECT NVL(SUM(O.PAY_AMT), 0) FROM TB_ORD O WHERE O.MBR_ID = #{mbrId} AND O.ORD_STAT = '60' AND O.CNFM_DT >= ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM'), -6) AND O.CNFM_DT < TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM')

SELECT M.MBR_ID, NVL(M.GRADE_CD, 'GEN') AS GRADE_CD, NVL(O.CNFM_AMT, 0) AS CNFM_AMT_6M FROM TB_MBR M LEFT JOIN ( SELECT MBR_ID, SUM(PAY_AMT) AS CNFM_AMT FROM TB_ORD WHERE ORD_STAT = '60' AND CNFM_DT >= ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM'), -6) AND CNFM_DT < TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM') GROUP BY MBR_ID ) O ON O.MBR_ID = M.MBR_ID WHERE M.MBR_STAT <> 'D' ORDER BY M.MBR_ID
SELECT MBR_ID FROM TB_MBR WHERE MBR_STAT = 'A' AND NVL(LAST_LOGIN_DT, JOIN_DT) < ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE), -#{DRMNT_MONTHS})
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_MBR SET MBR_STAT = 'D', DRMNT_DT = SYSDATE, UPD_ID = #{USER_ID}, UPD_DT = SYSDATE WHERE MBR_ID = #{MBR_ID} AND MBR_STAT = 'A'
